Rotation file.description: An .apl.siml rotation: the version and spec lines, a prepull and a priority list.

when block.description: Rows that each read with the block's condition joined to their own.

Group.description: A group of rows, which a group row runs.

Sequence.description: A sequence of actions, cast in order.

Def.description: A value with parameters, read at each call.

Refresh a DoT.description: Casts a DoT when it is off the target or its remaining time is at or below a threshold.

Keep a debuff on the target.description: Casts a spell when its debuff on the current target is missing or about to run out.

Keep a buff up.description: Casts a spell whenever its buff is not on you.

Use a cooldown while another is active.description: Casts a spell only while an aura, such as another cooldown, is on you.

Line up two cooldowns.description: Casts a cooldown while another one is active, or when the other is too far from ready to wait for.

Cast in the execute phase.description: Casts a spell only once the target is below the execute threshold.

Outside the execute phase.description: True while the target is above the execute threshold.

Cast above a resource amount.description: Casts a spell only while a resource is at or above an amount, keeping some back for higher rows.

Toggle is on.description: True while the row referencing a toggle group is shown.

Potion.description: Drinks the selected offensive potion as soon as it is ready; placed near the top, that is at the pull.

Prepull sequence.description: Casts spells before the pull, the first at a start time and each next one a gap later.
